draft.shortGloss: to tell; to explain; to show
draft.emotion: helpful and direct, providing information clearly to someone else
notes: The person being told takes को (e.g., मुझे बताओ — tell me). Being a transitive verb, its subject takes ने in perfective tenses.
Unlike कहना (to say), बताना focuses on giving specific information or an answer.

senses.definition: To give information or an answer to someone.
To explain, point out, or show how something works or where something is.
